Pooled recover: MODERN skip-free 23/23, with-skip 24/25; NOVOWEL skip-free 28/28, with-skip 18/20. 3 failures, all prefilter misses (2 of them NOVOWEL with-skip). Gate >=3 recoveries each split passed. Coordinator to decide whether the 2 NOVOWEL with-skip screen misses meet the 'fix harness' rule (judged consistent with I1 power 0.96).
